fs_list.description: Lists all files and subdirectories inside a directory path, providing entry names, types (file/directory), and sizes. Accepts relative paths or ~ expansion.

fs_read.description: Reads and prints the text content of any file (up to 10,000 characters). Resolves relative paths or ~ expansion.

sys_info.description: Returns operating system details, CPU cores, RAM usage, root disk space, and uptime as JSON.

take_screenshot.description: Captures a desktop screenshot and saves it as an image file. The runtime automatically sends the captured photo to the user.

web_screenshot.description: Visits a website URL and captures a screenshot of the webpage using headless browser. The runtime automatically sends the captured photo to the user.

install_tesseract_ocr.description: Installs Tesseract OCR on the system using apt-get, with sudo and password.

run_tesseract_ocr.description: Run tesseract OCR on a given image file and output extracted text

list_flatpak_apps.description: Run the command `flatpak list --app --columns=application,branch,version,installed` to retrieve a list of all installed Flatpak applications on the system and print the output to the console.

open_zen_browser.description: Run the command to launch Zen Browser via Flatpak: `flatpak run app.zen_browser.zen`. The tool should execute the command and print any output or errors.
